notes.title: Update Notes for Mar 26 (build 17862816)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Reassign seats after the North Wind player steps down as North round banker.
[*] Display current seat positions at the start of the game and after seat reassignment.
[*] Fixed an issue where players in the game could not see the leave notification when another player failed to join midway
[*] Fixed unexpected performance overhead caused by unstable network conditions
[*] Added 3new achievements: Banker 3+3, Banker 4+4, Banker 5+5
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for Mar 24 (build 17835812)
notes.content:
[h2]Added a new [b]Quick Play[/b] mode![/h2]
Host a game instantly and jump right in with AI opponents — no setup required. Friends or other players can join your session anytime for spontaneous fun!

notes.title: Update Notes for Mar 21 (build 17798997)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the game could freeze for remaining players when the host left.
[*] A countdown screen will now appear before starting a new game if the host leaves, to prevent sudden restarts.
[*] Adjusted the color of the chat guidance text to make it more noticeable.
[*] When selecting a hand card, identical cards on the table will also highlight to make calculation easier.
[*] Added three new achievements: Pong Pong, Mix, and Single suit
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526027/f6d4ff596207c682be6303df8b4e8fd263a84eec.png[/img]

notes.title: Update Notes for Mar 20 (build 17794768)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Resolved an issue where the new "Discard Assist" feature caused failures in multiplayer gameplay.
[*] Fixed a crash caused by unexpected Steam Cloud file synchronization.
[*] Improved mouse interactions in the leaderboard for a smoother experience.
[*] Fixed an issue where the host could crash if a player joined mid-game.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for Mar 19 (build 17770550)
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where player discard animations would shift abnormally.
[*]Added a new "Master" level AI and adjusted the difficulty of the existing four AI levels, with significant reductions for the "Monkey" and "Novice" levels.
[*]Adjusted the position of the candidate-assist display to avoid overlapping with the chat window.
[*]Fixed an issue where flower replacement sound effects would overlap with discard sound effects.
[*]Added a discard suggestion feature, available in Casual Mode, where the AI will offer recommended discards.
[*]Updated the "Game Introduction & Tutorial" section with a new "Game Assist" explanation.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526027/fdd29b16ee8490ba7f16246c67876dba39466e86.png[/img]
